# Remediation reports

Generated by `tests/remediation.rs::remediation_reports_match_environment_neutral_lf_goldens`
with `UPDATE_GOLDENS=1`. Each family records the complete mutation envelope and
remediation report for both publication and dry run.

Inputs are the committed dangling-style DOCX, missing-chart-source XLSX, and
inherited-title/chart-overlap PPTX fixtures. The harness copies each input,
runs `check --fix --openxml-sdk skip`, proves strict validation of the published
package, and compares the input bytes after both runs. The typed MCP parity
test independently compares reports, envelopes, and package bytes.

Temporary input/output names and their generated proof-command variants use
stable placeholders. The shared path scrubber handles quoted, native Windows,
escaped, verbatim, and macOS canonical paths before shorter forms. All JSON
goldens have `text eol=lf` through `.gitattributes`.

SDK availability is checked separately from the golden, and
`OOXML_REQUIRE_OPENXML_SDK=1` makes a skipped SDK proof fail. Tool inventory and
render-engine availability are never part of these snapshots. These reports
prove the recorded repairs and package validation; they do not claim recovery
of missing source data or desktop Office compatibility.
